topic: Fingers have no muscles: tendons, forearm muscles, ring finger trick, carpal tunnel
caption:
Your fingers have no muscles inside them. Every grip, tap and typed word is powered by muscles in your palm and forearm that pull on long tendons, like strings on a puppet.

That is why your forearm moves when you wiggle your fingers, and why one swollen spot in your wrist, the carpal tunnel, can numb your whole hand. Follow for one body fact your brain won't believe, every day.

Did you try the ring finger trick? Could you lift it?

3/4 The ring finger trap (Try it)
Fold your middle finger under, fingertips flat on a table. Your ring finger barely lifts: it shares tendons with its neighbors.

4/4 9 tendons, one tunnel (9)
Nine finger tendons and a nerve squeeze through one narrow wrist channel. Swelling there causes carpal tunnel syndrome.
